name: Shuvovai Bullion Rates for Kolkata Widget
author: shuvovai

sections.description:
Shuvovai Bullion Rates for Kolkata Widget is a free WordPress plugin designed to display live gold and silver prices for Kolkata, India. It is useful for publishers, bloggers, jewellery websites, financial information websites, and users who publish India bullion market updates. With this plugin, you can provide visitors with regularly updated Kolkata gold price today information directly on a WordPress website.

The widget supports automatic updates through the configured external service and also provides manual price controls when administrators need to manage displayed values. The plugin includes a responsive frontend design, customizable settings, and a built-in calculator supporting Bori, Gram, Ana, and Roti.

Features:
* Free WordPress widget for Kolkata gold and silver prices.
* Live pricing support through the configured external service.
* Shortcode support: [kgpl_kolkata_gold_live].
* Built-in calculator for Bori, Gram, Ana, and Roti.
* Manual price override options.
* Customizable colors and widget titles.
* Bengali language support.
* Suitable for gold price blogs, bullion information websites, jewellery publishers, and market update pages.

India Gold Price Resources

For publishers covering the Indian bullion market, access to regularly updated and location-specific information can be useful when preparing market content. Gold Live India provides live gold prices in India and information related to Indian gold rates, bullion market updates, and city-focused pricing pages. For users and publishers specifically interested in West Bengal, the Kolkata gold price today page can be used as a reference when checking current market information before publishing gold-related articles. These resources are intended to help users research market information. Gold and silver prices may change frequently, so publishers should verify the latest information before making financial or commercial decisions.

Bangladesh BAJUS Gold Price Resources

Publishers who cover the Bangladesh jewellery market may also need access to Bangladesh-specific gold price information. For checking BAJUS gold price today in Bangladesh, publishers and readers can review current carat-based gold price information and related Bangladesh jewellery market updates. Another independent resource for following the Bangladesh gold price today can be useful when researching live gold rates, daily market changes, and BAJUS-related price information. These websites focus on Bangladesh market information and may be useful for readers looking for regional gold price updates. Website owners should independently verify the latest market data and final jewellery prices with relevant sources or sellers.

Free Online Image Tools for Website Publishers

Images are an important part of modern blogging, product publishing, news articles, and website content. Publishers often need to prepare images before uploading them to WordPress or other content management systems. If you publish blog posts, product pages, jewellery articles, market updates, tutorials, or other online content, you may need to remove background from an image online when a photo has an unwanted or distracting background.

ImageBG.org provides free online image tools for common image editing and preparation tasks. Depending on the tool and image type, users can remove image backgrounds, crop images, compress large image files, and convert supported image formats. For website owners and content creators, an online background remover can be useful when preparing product photos, transparent images, featured images, graphics, and other visual content for publishing. Users may also use free image optimization tools to prepare web images before uploading them to a website. Reducing unnecessarily large image files and choosing an appropriate image format can help improve the publishing workflow and make images easier to manage. ImageBG.org is intended as a general-purpose image tools website for bloggers, website owners, designers, online sellers, and content creators who need simple browser-based tools for image preparation.

External Services

This plugin utilizes a third-party/external API service to retrieve real-time gold and silver rates.

  • Service Name: Gold Live India Server API
  • What it is used for: It fetches supported gold and silver pricing data for display inside the widget.
  • What data is sent and when: When this plugin is activated or when the widget fetches data, it may securely send your website’s domain name (for example, yoursite.com) to the API server for domain registration, authentication, or connection validation. No visitor personal data is intentionally collected or sent as part of the normal price retrieval process.
  • Service Provider: Gold Live India
  • Terms of Service: Terms of Service
  • Privacy Policy: Privacy Policy

Disclaimer

Gold and silver prices can change frequently. Information displayed by the plugin depends on the availability and response of the configured external service or administrator-defined manual prices. Website owners are responsible for reviewing displayed information before using it for financial, commercial, or purchasing decisions. This plugin does not provide financial or investment advice.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the “Kolkata Gold Live” menu in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  4. Configure the colors and/or manual prices as needed.
  5. Use the shortcode [kgpl_kolkata_gold_live] on any page, post, or supported widget area to display the widget.
sections.faq:
How do I display the widget?

Simply use the [kgpl_kolkata_gold_live] shortcode inside any post, page, or supported widget area.

Can I set manual prices?

Yes. You can input manual prices from the plugin settings page. This can be useful when you need to temporarily display administrator-defined values.

Does the plugin support Bengali?

Yes. The plugin includes Bengali language support for relevant functionality.

Where can I check Kolkata gold price information?

You can research regularly updated Kolkata gold price today information before publishing market-related content.

Where can I find Bangladesh BAJUS gold price information?

For Bangladesh-focused research, you may check BAJUS gold price today and Bangladesh gold price updates from relevant independent sources.

How can I remove an image background before publishing?

Website owners and bloggers can use an online image background remover to prepare suitable images for articles, product pages, featured images, and other web content.

Can I optimize images before uploading them to my website?

Yes. You can use free online image tools to prepare images by removing backgrounds, cropping, compressing files, or converting supported formats.
